manifest.description: Local AI quota monitor for Antigravity, Claude Pro/Max quotas, Enterprise spend and Codex. Independent preview derived from Quota Nexus.
manifest.setting.display.percentMode.des: Display quota as used or remaining.
How often to check sources. Claude queries are cached for five minutes.
manifest.setting.refresh.pauseWhenUnfocu: Pause polling when the editor is in the background.
manifest.setting.context.show.descriptio: Show conversation context in a separate details section.
manifest.setting.display.timeZone.descri: Timezone for absolute reset and source timestamps.
manifest.setting.display.language.descri: Changes the dashboard, quick settings and status bar. Command names and native Settings follow the editor language.
manifest.setting.statusBar.show.descript: Show the usage item in the status bar. Hover over it to see all monitored limits.
manifest.setting.statusBar.compact.descr: Show a single quota gauge icon in the status bar. Hover for all monitored limits or click to open the dashboard.
manifest.setting.antigravity.enable.desc: Monitor this provider in this extension host.
manifest.setting.antigravity.showInStatu: Include this provider in the status bar. If unset, automatically show it when quota or spend data is found.
manifest.setting.antigravity.statusBar.g: Show Gemini Models 5-hour in the status bar. Only changes the selected summary; the hover and dashboard retain all limits. Deselect every window to omit Antigravity from the status bar.
Show Gemini Models weekly in the status bar. Only changes the selected summary; the hover and dashboard retain all limits. Deselect every window to omit Antigravity from the status bar.
manifest.setting.antigravity.statusBar.c: Show Claude and GPT models 5-hour in the status bar. Only changes the selected summary; the hover and dashboard retain all limits. Deselect every window to omit Antigravity from the status bar.
Show Claude and GPT models weekly in the status bar. Only changes the selected summary; the hover and dashboard retain all limits. Deselect every window to omit Antigravity from the status bar.
manifest.setting.antigravity.statusBar.a: Show Gemini 4 Argon weekly in the status bar. Only changes the selected summary; the hover and dashboard retain all limits. Deselect every window to omit Antigravity from the status bar.
manifest.setting.antigravity.statusBar.o: Include detected Antigravity quota windows without an individual setting in the status bar.
manifest.setting.claudeCode.enable.descr: Monitor this provider in this extension host.
manifest.setting.claudeCode.showInStatus: Include this provider in the status bar. If unset, automatically show it when quota or spend data is found.
manifest.setting.claudeCode.timeoutSecon: Maximum time for the official CLI usage query.
manifest.setting.claudeCode.enterpriseRe: Enterprise spend only: when no source reset is available, use the official monthly rule confirmed against your Usage page. Select Source only if your plan uses a different period. The UI labels rule-derived times.
manifest.setting.codex.enable.descriptio: Monitor this provider in this extension host.
manifest.setting.codex.showInStatusBar.d: Include this provider in the status bar. If unset, automatically show it when quota or spend data is found.
